With an active embedding model, memory indexing and question embeddings may also cost extra. New messages are processed in batches by a model to extract and update independent memories. Context compaction also creates separate episodic archives, without merging a lifetime summary. These extra calls use tokens and may cost money, including later retries after failures. Existing history is not automatically backfilled. Reference model: %1$s; reference rates: input %2$s and output %3$s USD per million tokens. Total cost cannot be predicted; routing or failover may change model and rates. Save this page after confirming.

Long-term companionship uses independent memories. Automatic continuity with ordinary mode is not supported yet. After enabling or switching modes, your companion may be unable to recall some memories from the other mode. Original chats are preserved. We recommend continuing with the same mode in the same conversation.

Both independent memory collections share keyword and vector search. Activate an embedding model to build indexes; keyword search remains available without it or when the API fails. Indexing and question embeddings may cost extra. No automatic fallback model is used.

Optional free embedding model: SiliconFlow BAAI/bge-m3, available at cloud.siliconflow.cn. Configure your own API key and activate the embedding purpose. Pro/BAAI/bge-m3 is paid; check current platform pricing and limits.
